content:
taylor: Quick heads-up — I'm finalizing the release notes draft for the 0.10.0 docs push. Can folks do a fast sweep for accuracy and SDK snippet updates? Need this before EOD so the product team can sign off.

sasha: On it. Which parts are you most worried about?

taylor: Mainly the embeddings section (we're deprecating streaming embeddings API in favor of the batched endpoint), the new adaptive routing blurb, and a tiny migration note for Dedicated customers re: autoscaler behavior.

leo: I'll check the embeddings/SDK snippets. I noticed one JS example still uses streaming: `client.embeddingsStream(...)` — should be `client.embeddings.batch(...)` now.

annah: I'll take the release notes known-issues block. There's an outstanding internal ticket about Dedicated fallback causing intermittent 503s when the autoscaler spins up GPUs — product wants that listed as "under investigation" with a mitigations note.

mike: FYI PRs: #4682 updates sample code and #4699 adds canary notes. I'll link them in the draft.

release-bot: Draft changelog generated: https://git.redwood-inference/release/0.10.0/changelog-draft.md (automated).

leo: Quick sample fix suggestion for JS snippet:
```js
// old
const r = await client.embeddingsStream({ model: 'embed-small', input: 'text' })

// new
const r = await client.embeddings.batch({ model: 'embed-small', inputs: ['text'] })
```
Make sure we also add a migration note for token counting differences.

annah: For Dedicated autoscaler I propose wording: "Known issue: under certain sustained burst patterns, the autoscaler may briefly return 503s while capacity is provisioned. Mitigation: enable burst-capacity or configure canary fallback to hosted for critical routes." Thoughts?

sasha: Good. Can we add a short code/config snippet showing the canary fallback config? e.g., route policy JSON?

leo: Sure, something like:
```json
{
  "route": "/api/generate",
  "policy": "canary",
  "primary": { "deployment": "dedicated-v1" },
  "fallback": { "deployment": "hosted-small", "max_latency_ms": 1200 }
}
```

taylor: Perfect. Also double-check internal links — last time a redirect broke the quickstart snippet link. I'm seeing a 302 on https://docs.redwood.ai/snippets/old-embed -> should point to /snippets/embed-batch now.

mike: I found two other stale links in the changelog: one to the legacy quantization guide and one to the old caching FAQ. I'll push a tiny PR to patch them (#4703).

docs-bot: Reminder: Docs PR checklist — update SDK samples, run snippet-lint, add changelog blurb, and ping product for approval before merge.

sasha: I'll run snippet-lint and post results here in ~30m.

leo: Leaving a tiny editorial nudge: the adaptive routing paragraph reads a bit marketing-y. Suggest: replace "magically routes" with "routes by cost and latency policy".

annah: +1 to that wording change. Also add the canary example under "Rollouts" not the main whats-new so it doesn't look like GA guidance.

taylor: Great notes. Plan: Sasha + Leo do code/link sweep, Annah writes the known-issues blurb, Mike patches links, I will stitch everything into the draft and ping product for sign-off. Aim to merge by 5pm PT.

mike: I'll queue PRs and add reviewers. If product stalls, we can ship an abbreviated whats-new and follow up with a detailed changelog later.

release-bot: Scheduled publish window: 2026-03-25 16:00 PT.

docs-bot: If anyone makes breaking sample changes, add a short migration guide under /docs/migration/0.10.0 to avoid customer confusion.

taylor: Thanks all — post any last-minute fixes here. :thumbsup:

sasha: snippet-lint: 0 errors, 2 warnings (deprecated API usage) — will submit fix PR in 10m.

leo: PR #4682 updated, includes migration note for token counting.

annah: Drafted known-issues paragraph and added the autoscaler mitigation steps. Pushing PR now.

mike: Link fix PR #4703 merged.

release-bot: Changelog updated with merged PRs. Final draft: https://git.redwood-inference/release/0.10.0/changelog-final.md

 taylor: Merged and scheduled. Thanks everyone!"
